notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 run wD-009 and reviewed_by is null. No hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python PourWater stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream PyFlex simulator. The sim backend was not run: it needs PyFlex compiled (README.md:22) and register_flex_envs() called (softgym/__init__.py:9, the clone defines it but never calls it). The driver serves the key_point observation mode (13 floats, pour_water.py:32-41 and :368-370) and the rotation_bottom action mode (3-element Box, pour_water.py:49-54); env_kwargs override the registration's action_mode='direct' (softgym/__init__.py:21), which the class rejects (pour_water.py:23), and keep the registered horizon of 75 (softgym/__init__.py:26). NOT COVERED: the cam_rgb image (720 x 720 x 3, pour_water.py:44-45) and the point_cloud particle array; cap.world.render.v1 is unbound. The fake is F0 analytic: no fluid particles, contacts, friction or rendering; its start pose and glass dimensions are placeholders, and it was not compared with the upstream environment. Snapshot and restore are not offered although the class defines get_state/set_state (pour_water.py:161-187). The legacy four-value step return has one done flag, which the bridge serves at the horizon as terminated=True and truncated=False. Accepted warnings from the last gate run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT (seed in reset, seed in seed, action.values[*], ticks); these are the expected Gymnasium-family warnings. There were no G4 warnings. No catalogue_requests: only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used. No site-limits.example.json: the driver declares no operator-required bound. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
